quote: As a consultant, I want to drill into one family of competencies, so I am not scrolling past a thousand rows to reach the ten that describe me.
Picking a Type narrows the Area dropdown to that Type's Areas and the grid to that Type's rows.
As a consultant, I want to type the name of the thing I know, because that is faster than navigating to it.
Typing in the competency box leaves only the rows whose competency name contains what was typed, ignoring case and accents.
As a consultant, I want to review what I have already claimed, because correcting an old profile is a different job from filling a new one.
With Mine switched on, the grid shows only competencies where this person has a level recorded.
As a consultant, I want to see only what is new since I was last here, so a two-month gap does not mean re-reading the whole catalogue.
With New switched on, the grid shows only competencies that were added to the catalogue after the last time this person changed any of their own levels.
As a consultant, I want one level per competency, because "I am a Learner and an Expert at Jira" is not a thing a person can be.
Ticking a level on a row that already holds a different one records the new level and clears the old, leaving exactly one of Learner, Advanced, Expert ticked on that row.
As a consultant, I want to take a claim back, because a mis-click should not become a permanent statement about me.
Unticking the level a row currently holds deletes the claim outright and returns the row to unrated - which is a real state, distinct from "Learner".
As a consultant, I want my click to be the whole interaction, so I never lose work by closing a tab.
Every level change is written as it happens, with no further action from the person.
As a consultant, I want to be told when a click did not land, because silence would let me believe something false was recorded about me.
If a level change fails to write, the row goes back to its last saved level and a non-blocking message names the competency and says it was not saved.
As a consultant, I want to just be signed in, because this is an internal tool and I already have a corporate identity.
Opening any page unauthenticated sends the person to Microsoft Entra ID and brings them back to the page they asked for, signed in as their directory identity.
The app stands alone. It owns its own PostgreSQL database and has exactly one live dependency - Microsoft Entra ID, for sign- in over OIDC with the authorization-code flow and PKCE.
